policy: Source-bound editorial reading order, distinct from numerical scores. Direct quotations preserve source wording with whitespace normalization only; paraphrases are labeled. Changed question, proof account or result scope disables the pin until reviewed. Inclusion does not assert novelty or author endorsement.

pins.reason: Erdős proposes, in print, that 23 may be the only counterexample; a second one is exhibited and kernel-checked.
pins.headline: Erdős suggested 23 might be the only counterexample. 47 is another.
pins.quote: I would not be surprised if 23 is the only counterexample.
pins.scope: Only the proposed uniqueness of 23 is refuted; conjecture (22) and the classification of all counterexamples remain outside this result.

zh-CN.headline: Erdős 推测 23 可能是唯一反例。47 也是。
zh-CN.quote: 如果 23 是唯一的反例，我也不会感到意外。
zh-CN.scope: 仅推翻“23 是唯一反例”的推测；不涉及猜想 (22)，也不穷尽所有反例。

pins.reason: An explicit unanswered question in the Annals of Probability, answered under the source model and the stated graph hypotheses.
pins.headline: The noisy voter model: the repetition variance is never sublinear
pins.quote: May Var(ζ₁ + … + ζ_t) be sublinear? We do not have an answer.
pins.quote_by: I. Benjamini, H. Helman Tov, M. Zhukovskii
pins.scope: Synchronous noisy voter dynamics on connected locally finite simple graphs with a neighbor at every vertex, fair independent opinions, noise 0 < ε < 1 and positive lag.

zh-CN.headline: 含噪投票模型：重复事件的方差不可能次线性增长
zh-CN.quote: Var(ζ₁ + … + ζ_t) 能否次线性增长？我们没有答案。
zh-CN.scope: 适用于同步含噪投票模型：连通局部有限简单图、每个顶点均有邻居、独立公平意见、噪声 0 < ε < 1，且观察时滞为正。

pins.reason: The open problem that closes the paper; answered affirmatively with an explicit local model.
pins.headline: A fully symmetric local triangle model beats 1/4
pins.quote: Open problem. Does there exist a distribution p(A,B,C) that is local in the triangle network and fully symmetric such that p(A=B=C) > 1/4?
pins.quote_by: E. Bäumer, V. Gitton, T. Kriváchy, N. Gisin, R. Renner
pins.scope: Four outcomes per party, independent local triangle sources, and symmetry under party permutations and joint outcome relabelings. The witness refutes the universal 1/4 bound.

zh-CN.headline: 完全对称的局域三角网络模型突破 1/4
zh-CN.quote: 开放问题：是否存在三角网络中的局域且完全对称的分布 p(A,B,C)，使 p(A=B=C) > 1/4？
zh-CN.scope: 每方四种输出、相互独立的局域三角网络源，并满足参与方置换和共同输出重标记对称性。该构造推翻普遍的 1/4 上界。

pins.reason: The authors call it the main open question of their paper; refuted by an explicit four-level faithful pair.
pins.headline: Hiai, Mosonyi and Hayashi’s main open question: ψ need not be differentiable
pins.quote: The main open question of the present work is to show that this is indeed the case.
pins.quote_by: F. Hiai, M. Mosonyi, M. Hayashi
pins.answer: No: a corner at s = ½
pins.scope: A finite-group counterexample with faithful states and the stated asymptotic convergence premise; the question is differentiability of ψ on (0, 1).

zh-CN.headline: Hiai、Mosonyi 与 Hayashi 的主要开放问题：ψ 可以不可微
zh-CN.quote: 本文的主要开放问题是证明情况确实如此。
zh-CN.answer: 不能：s = ½ 处出现尖点
zh-CN.scope: 在有限群、忠实态及所声明的渐近收敛前提下给出反例；回答的是 ψ 在 (0, 1) 上的可微性问题。

pins.reason: A named conjecture in PRX Quantum, checked by the authors for 5 ≤ d ≤ 23; proved for every d ≥ 5.
pins.headline: The Torpedo Game has a perfect classical strategy in every dimension d ≥ 5
pins.quote_by: P.-E. Emeriau, M. Howard, S. Mansfield
pins.scope: Perfect classical winning probability for the dimension-d Torpedo Game, for every integer d ≥ 5; the source had checked 5 ≤ d ≤ 23.

zh-CN.headline: 每个 d ≥ 5 的 Torpedo Game 都存在完美经典策略
zh-CN.scope: 对每个整数 d ≥ 5，d 维 Torpedo Game 的经典策略胜率均可达到 1；原文验证的范围为 5 ≤ d ≤ 23。

pins.reason: Conjecture 5 in IEEE Transactions on Information Theory; proved for all three statistical-strength conventions in the paper.
pins.headline: Two singlets are more than twice as strong as CHSH
pins.quote: Can a 2×4×4 experiment using joint measurements on pairs of Bell singlets be more than twice as strong as CHSH?
pins.quote_by: W. van Dam, R. D. Gill, P. D. Grünwald
pins.scope: Statistical strength means KL divergence in bits, under the uniform, product and correlated setting distributions defined in the source.
pins.source_excerpt: There is an experiment on pairs of Bell singlets, of the $2\times4\times4$ type, more than twice as strong as CHSH, and involving joint measurements on the pairs.

zh-CN.headline: 两对单态的统计强度超过 CHSH 的两倍
zh-CN.quote: 是否存在使用两对 Bell 单态的 2×4×4 型联合测量实验，其统计强度超过 CHSH 的两倍？
zh-CN.scope: “统计强度”指以比特计的 KL 散度，采用原文定义的均匀、乘积及相关测量设置分布。

pins.reason: Conjecture 1 of a 2025 paper, supported there by numerical evidence; refuted by a three-qubit witness.
pins.headline: Spacetime density matrices violate Schatten subadditivity
pins.quote: Conjecture 1 For any T_AB on a finite-dimensional H_A ⊗ H_B and p > 1: 1 + ||T_AB||_p ≥ ||Tr_A T_AB||_p + ||Tr_B T_AB||_p.
pins.quote_by: A. Milekhin, Z. Adamska, J. Preskill
pins.scope: A three-qubit witness at Schatten exponent p = 2 refutes Conjecture 1 for spacetime density matrices.

zh-CN.headline: 时空密度矩阵不满足 Schatten 次可加性
zh-CN.quote: 猜想 1：对有限维 H_A ⊗ H_B 上的任意 T_AB 以及 p > 1，有 1 + ||T_AB||_p ≥ ||Tr_A T_AB||_p + ||Tr_B T_AB||_p。
zh-CN.scope: 一个 Schatten 指数 p = 2 的三量子比特反例推翻时空密度矩阵的猜想 1。

pins.reason: An explicit optimality conjecture; refuted in dimension two under the preregistered one-site reading.
pins.headline: Purify-and-clone is not optimal beyond m = n
pins.quote: This channel is optimal for m ≤ n (see Ref. [S2]), and we conjecture that it is also optimal for m > n.
pins.quote_by: Z. Li, E. Theil, A. W. Harrow, I. Chuang
pins.scope: The counterexample has n = 1, m = 2 and d = r = 2, under the one-site worst-case squared-infidelity reading.

zh-CN.headline: Purify-and-clone 在 m > n 时并非总是最优
zh-CN.quote: 该信道在 m ≤ n 时最优（见参考文献 [S2]），我们猜想它在 m > n 时也最优。
zh-CN.scope: 反例取 n = 1、m = 2、d = r = 2，采用单站点最坏情形平方不保真度的解读。

pins.reason: Mahler's suggested uniqueness, as recorded by Erdős; refuted by an explicit coprime square. Note: 11677 also appears in OEIS A342546 under a different framing.
pins.headline: Mahler's 0/1-digit square was not unique
pins.quote: In fact, the only nontrivial solution he found was 7^3 + 7^2 + 7 + 1 = 20^2, and perhaps there are no others
pins.scope: A counterexample to the suggested uniqueness of a nontrivial coprime 0/1-digit square, as recorded by Erdős; not Mahler’s fixed-base finiteness conjecture.

zh-CN.headline: Mahler 找到的 0/1 数字平方并不唯一
zh-CN.quote: 实际上，他找到的唯一非平凡解是 7^3 + 7^2 + 7 + 1 = 20^2，也许没有其他解了
zh-CN.scope: 反驳的是 Erdős 记述的非平凡互素 0/1 数字平方唯一性推测，并非 Mahler 关于固定底数的有限性猜想。

pins.reason: Conjecture III.2 of Chen, Kato and Brandão; refuted by a qubit channel with local contraction ratio at most 1/√2.
pins.headline: No uniform contraction for trace-norm conditional mutual information
pins.quote: Must a locally strictly contracting channel uniformly contract trace-norm conditional mutual information?
pins.quote_by: C.-F. Chen, K. Kato, F. G. S. L. Brandão
pins.scope: A qubit channel with local trace-norm contraction ratio at most 1/√2 refutes the claimed uniform contraction of trace-norm conditional mutual information.
pins.source_excerpt: For any channel $\mathcal E: C \rightarrow C'$ with local contraction ratio $\eta_{1,C}:=\sup_{\rho_C,\rho'_C}\frac{\lVert\mathcal E_C[\rho_{C}]-\mathcal E_C[\rho'_{C}]\rVert_1 }{\lVert\rho_{C}-\rho'_{C}\rVert_1} <1$ There exists a global constant $\eta < 1$ such that for any tripartite system $ABC$ and any state $\rho_{ABC}$, it holds that $I_1(A:C'|B)_{\mathcal E(\rho)} \le \eta I_1(A:C|B)_\rho$.

zh-CN.headline: 迹范数条件互信息不存在所猜想的统一收缩
zh-CN.quote: 局部严格收缩的信道是否也会统一收缩迹范数条件互信息？
zh-CN.scope: 一个局部迹范数收缩率至多为 1/√2 的量子比特信道，推翻迹范数条件互信息的统一收缩断言。
